subject: POC: Three-wave 'Orbit' hands-on schedule & roles
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@shoplytics.com>, Priya Singh <priya.s@shoplytics.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC: Three-wave 'Orbit' hands-on schedule & roles

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for agreeing to a hands-on POC. To keep the working sessions accessible across Shoplytics' QA, infra, and product teams, we'd like to run three short "waves" over two business days (each ~2.5 hours) so your folks in US / EU / APAC can join at reasonable times. High-level agenda per wave:

- 30m: Prompt review & success criteria
- 45m: Routing & model variant checks (latency/cost tradeoffs)
- 30m: Load test #1 (steady-state)
- 30m: Load test #2 (burst/recovery)
- 15–20m: Retrospective & action items

Proposed windows (local-friendly labels):
- Wave A (US-morning / EU-afternoon): 2026-06-02 15:00–17:30 UTC
- Wave B (EU-morning / APAC-evening): 2026-06-03 08:00–10:30 UTC
- Wave C (APAC-morning / US-late-afternoon): 2026-06-03 22:00–00:30 UTC

Attachments: shoplytics-poc-orbit-plan.pdf (agenda + runbook), orbit-load-test-matrix.xlsx (load profiles).

Can you confirm: 1) which wave(s) your team prefers, 2) any mandatory windows to avoid, and 3) whether your security team needs a pre-call before hands-on? We can optionally run the security review the day before.

I'll draft calendar invites once we lock times and will include a short pre-call for the MPA/terms if needed.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0192

- Our legal/security team requires a short vendor security sync before any hands-on access. Alice (security) will want to join that.

Prefer Wave A for our core team (US folks can join late morning PT). If Wave B works better for your engineers in EU, we can do Wave B but please avoid 13:00–14:00 CEST.

I'll add Alice to the thread, and Priya will follow up on available attendee list.
